featured_reviews.name: Kartikeya Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Decent Bakery Experience: Bangalore Iyangar Bakery Review

I recently ordered from Bangalore Iyangar Bakery on MG Road, Goregaon, and had their treats delivered to my home. We opted for the Mawa Cake and Marble Cake, and while they were decent, they didn't entirely blow me away.

Mawa Cake
The Mawa Cake was a classic rendition of the popular Indian dessert. The cake was moist and flavorful, with a subtle sweetness and a hint of cardamom. However, it lacked a bit of depth and richness that I've come to expect from a good Mawa Cake.

Marble Cake
The Marble Cake was a visually appealing treat, with a beautiful marbled design. The cake itself was soft and fluffy, with a subtle chocolate flavor. However, it was a bit too sweet for my taste, and the chocolate flavor could have been more pronounced.

Verdict
While the Bangalore Iyangar Bakery didn't entirely exceed my expectations, it's still a decent option for those seeking traditional Indian-style baked goods. The Mawa Cake and Marble Cake were enjoyable, if not outstanding, and the convenience of home delivery was a definite plus.

Price: Affordable (around ₹50-₹100 per cake)

Recommended for: Those seeking traditional Indian-style baked goods, casual snacks, and the convenience of home delivery.

Will I return?
Maybe, to try more of their offerings and see if they have any other hidden gems.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Arora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Isira Bakes is a true gem in Goregaon East—a wholly vegetarian bakery that elevates plant-based patisserie to remarkable heights. Each visit reveals impeccably fresh confections, crafted with care and free from preservatives, delivering flavours of exceptional purity and depth.
The pastries are sublime: shatteringly buttery croissants, moist layered cakes with nuanced frostings. Their eggless creations show no compromise in texture or taste an impressive feat.
Service is courteous and efficient, with packaging that keeps everything pristine. In a city of fleeting options, Isira Bakes offers consistent artisanal excellence that delights the discerning palate. A must-visit for vegetarians and connoisseurs alike; I shall return eagerly.

featured_reviews.name: Ankur Kapila
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re in Mumbai and looking for desserts that are genuinely healthy and delicious, Isira Bakes is a must-try.

They’ve nailed the balance, clean ingredients, perfect sweetness, and great texture without that “compromise” taste healthy bakes sometimes have. Everything feels fresh, thoughtfully made, and indulgent in the right way.

Highly recommend for guilt-free treats that don’t feel like a compromise at all.

featured_reviews.name: jitendra joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I usually don’t write reviews, but this one was well deserved. A friend who lives in the area — and is a big foodie like me — recommended Isira Bakes, and I’m really glad I tried it.

From the moment I walked in, it felt like discovering a hidden gem in Goregaon East. The aroma of freshly baked goodies is instantly comforting, and everything I tried lived up to the word of mouth. You can clearly feel that good quality ingredients are used — it shows in every bite.

From savouries and cookies to pastries, brownies, and mousses, everything felt thoughtfully made and nicely balanced. The team is warm and welcoming, and I also love that they’re available on Swiggy — very convenient. Definitely a place I’ll keep coming back to. 😊🍰

The portion size was just right for the price, and honestly, it was worth every bite. You can tell they used good-quality ingredients, and the presentation was neat even after delivery. It's the kind of dessert you'd happily reorder or serve to guests without a second thought.

Overall, I'd say this Lotus Biscoff Cheesecake is definitely worth trying if you enjoy rich, balanced desserts. Jaden Cakes did a great job with this one.

featured_reviews.name: Raksha Investmart
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered a 1kg Chocolate Truffle Masha and the Bear cake for my 5 years old nephew's birthday from The Cake House by Chef Mr. Pawan and Team, NNP Goregaon, and I am beyond impressed!

Design & Customization:
The cake looked exactly like the picture shown on the website, if not better! The detailing on the Masha and Bear characters was impeccable. It brought the forest house theme to life, and my nephew was ecstatic when he saw it.

Taste & Texture:
The chocolate truffle was divine—so rich, fudgy, and moist! It wasn't overly sweet, which was perfect. The layers were delicate, and the ganache was smooth, making it melt in our mouths. Even after being in the fridge, the cake stayed soft.

Service:
The delivery was on time, and the cake arrived in perfect condition. They paid great attention to the theme, making the celebration truly memorable.

This is the second time I have trusted this bakery for a themed party, and they never disappoint. Highly recommended for any parent looking for a high-quality, delicious, and beautiful custom cake!
